record.paper_title: Some open problems on the analysis of the Cauchy-Fueter system in several variables
record.context_brief: Fundamental solutions for hypercomplex wave linearizations
record.original_question: For the hypercomplex operators that linearize wave operators, study their fundamental solutions and provide integral formulas for the functions in their kernels.

evidence.quote: Problem: Study the fundamental solution of such operators and provide integral formulas for the functions in their kernel.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider first-order linear constant-coefficient differential operators $D$ acting on functions $f:\mathbb{R}^n\to A^k$ taking values in a real associative *-algebra $A$ (for example, the quaternions $\mathbb{H}$ or a Clifford algebra) with the property that $D$ "linearizes" a wave-type operator, in the sense that there exists a companion operator $\overline{D}$ such that the composition $\overline{D}\,D$ equals (a scalar multiple of) a wave operator
$$\Box = -\partial_{t}^{2} + \sum_{j=1}^{n-1}\varepsilon_j\,\partial_{x_j}^{2},\qquad \varepsilon_j\in\{+1,-1\},$$
on $\mathbb{R}^{1,n-1}$. Such operators arise as hypercomplex/Clifford-algebraic square roots of indefinite-signature Laplacians (Cauchy–Fueter–type operators in Lorentzian or split signatures).

The problem is twofold:

(a) Construct an explicit fundamental solution $E$ of $D$, i.e., an $A$-valued distribution on $\mathbb{R}^n$ satisfying $D E = \delta_0$, in a form analogous to the Cauchy–Fueter kernel of the elliptic case.

(b) Derive integral representation formulas (of Cauchy type) reproducing every sufficiently regular function $f$ in the kernel $\ker D$ on a suitable domain $\Omega\subset\mathbb{R}^n$ from its boundary values, via an integral kernel built from $E$.
artifact.status_search_result: Searches on fundamental solutions and Cauchy-type integral formulas for hypercomplex operators that linearize wave (indefinite-signature) operators turn up the general framework of Fueter/Sce mapping, Cauchy–Fueter kernels in the elliptic quaternionic and Clifford settings, and related recent developments (e.g., scaled global operators, Fock spaces in hypercomplex analysis), but no definitive, comprehensive resolution providing explicit fundamental solutions and integral kernel formulas for the Lorentzian/wave-linearizing hypercomplex operators was located. The status is therefore inconclusive from available evidence.

status_evidence.title: Cauchy-Fueter system in several variables (RIMS Kokyuroku)
status_evidence.snippet: Discussion of the Cauchy–Fueter system in several variables and related function theory.
status_evidence.claim: The Cauchy–Fueter system and its kernel functions (Fueter-regular functions) are the elliptic prototype the wave-linearizing analogue would generalize.

status_evidence.title: Scaled global operators and Fueter variables on non-zero scaled hypercomplex numbers
status_evidence.snippet: Develops Fueter-type operators in scaled hypercomplex settings.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work extends Fueter-type operators to new hypercomplex settings, but does not specifically resolve fundamental solutions for wave-linearizing operators.

status_evidence.title: Towards Fock Spaces in Hypercomplex Analysis
status_evidence.snippet: Recent (2025) developments in hypercomplex analysis function spaces.
status_evidence.claim: Active research continues in hypercomplex analysis without a located definitive solution to the stated problem.
